#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
  echo "usage: summarize.sh FILE" >&2
  exit 2
fi

file=$1

if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
  echo "error: file not found: $file" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! jq -e 'type == "array"' "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "error: not a valid JSON array of orders: $file" >&2
  exit 1
fi

orders=$(jq 'length' "$file")
paid=$(jq '[.[] | select(.status == "paid")] | length' "$file")
revenue=$(jq '[.[] | select(.status == "paid") | .total] | add // 0' "$file")
top=$(jq -r '
  [.[] | select(.status == "paid")]
  | group_by(.customer)
  | map({customer: .[0].customer, revenue: (map(.total) | add)})
  | sort_by([-.revenue, .customer])
  | if length == 0 then "-" else .[0].customer end
' "$file")

printf 'orders: %s\n' "$orders"
printf 'paid: %s\n' "$paid"
printf 'revenue: %.2f\n' "$revenue"
printf 'top: %s\n' "$top"

    return subprocess.run(["bash", str(SCRIPT), *args], capture_output=True, text=True)


def write_orders(tmp_path, orders, name="orders.json"):
    f = tmp_path / name
    f.write_text(json.dumps(orders))
    return f


def test_full_summary_lines(tmp_path):
    f = write_orders(
        tmp_path,
        [
            {"id": 1, "customer": "bob", "total": 10.5, "status": "paid"},
            {"id": 2, "customer": "alice", "total": 4, "status": "paid"},
            {"id": 3, "customer": "bob", "total": 1.25, "status": "pending"},
            {"id": 4, "customer": "carol", "total": 3.1, "status": "paid"},
        ],
    )

    assert out.returncode == 0
    assert out.stdout == "orders: 4\npaid: 3\nrevenue: 17.60\ntop: bob\n"

    f = write_orders(tmp_path, [{"id": 1, "customer": "x", "total": 7, "status": "paid"}])
